LESSON: HANDLING WASTE MATERIALS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Materials for Production
Topic 3.2: Handling Waste Materials

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Handling Waste Materials. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Handling Waste Materials
2. Practise Handling Waste Materials at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Handling Waste Materials

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Handling Waste Materials
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Handling Waste Materials. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Handling Waste Materials at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Handling Waste Materials at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Handling Waste Materials
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Handling Waste Materials. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Handling Waste Materials using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Handling Waste Materials in the examples.
2. Explain Handling Waste Materials to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Handling Waste Materials.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Handling Waste Materials using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Handling Waste Materials important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Handling Waste Materials
2. Practise Handling Waste Materials at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Handling Waste Materials

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
